title: Complete onboarding and receive matched schemes with risk guidance
description: A citizen completes onboarding and receives matched welfare schemes, required documents, and a rejection risk assessment to decide whether to apply online or seek CSC support.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the onboarding flow
Complete the first onboarding step with valid personal details
Complete the second onboarding step with valid socioeconomic details
Complete the third onboarding step with valid document readiness and digital literacy details
Verify matched schemes are displayed
Verify a rejection risk assessment with explanation data is displayed

title: Display risk score and SHAP barriers for a completed profile
description: A citizen receives a risk score, risk band, and top contributing barriers so they can decide between online filing and CSC assistance.
category: Access Risk Meter and SHAP Explainability

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the risk assessment flow
Complete the profile with valid risk input values
Verify a risk score is displayed
Verify SHAP barrier explanations are displayed

title: Book a priority token at a selected CSC kiosk
description: A citizen can choose a listed kiosk, submit booking details, and receive an immutable appointment token with QR pass details.
category: CSC Kiosk Locator and Priority Booking

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the CSC kiosk locator
Enter a valid district or pincode filter
Search for nearby kiosks
Select a kiosk from the results
Fill in the citizen booking details
Submit the token booking
Verify an appointment token is displayed
Verify QR pass details are displayed

title: Analyze a valid document for readiness issues
description: A citizen can upload a supported document image and receive extracted details and pre-screening findings that help decide whether the document is ready for filing.

steps.description: Navigate to /

Run the document analysis

Verify document readiness findings are displayed
